verdict.rationale: Canny documents an API (an API Reference page exists). Its official MCP server lets users take workflow actions such as updating statuses, linking deals, organizing requests and replying to customers. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers everything the UI can do, and no OpenAPI spec was found, so parity is unproven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoint coverage matching UI functionality, a published OpenAPI spec, any statement or corroboration of UI/API parity, and API coverage for admin and settings actions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Update statuses, link deals, organize requests, and reply to customers.
